response.title: which solar generators can recharge fully from their own panels in a single winter day
response.answer:
A solar generator can recharge from 0% to 100% in a single winter day, but the key is the ratio between its battery capacity and the wattage of its solar panels.

For a typical sunny winter day in the San Francisco Bay Area, I would design around 2–3 peak sun hours, rather than the 4–6 hours often used in manufacturers' marketing.

That means a 1,000Wh solar generator generally needs around 500–700W of panels for a reliable one-day winter recharge, assuming good panel positioning and little shade.
